title: Tria Standing Desk
description:
Overview

Make movement part of your everyday routine with the Tria Standing Desk, the do-it-all centerpiece that adjusts to your workflow while improving health and productivity. Three sizes up to 71” provide ample room for serious work, while three-stage lifting columns accommodate a wide range of statures. Built-in Bluetooth pairs with the Branch Ergonomics app to add automatic stand tracking, scheduled stands, and more.

Benefits

  • Three-stage lifting columns reach from 25.5" to 48.9", covering a wider range of statures both sitting and standing
  • Lift capacity of 275 lbs
  • Three generous desktop sizes (48”, 58”, 71”) provide ample room for serious work
  • Available in 5 desktop finishes to suit your workspace style
  • OLED keypad stores two programmable height presets with one-touch recall, and adds USB-C charging right where you work
  • Collision detection and sedentary reminders keep you moving safely
  • Integrated cable port and included felt organizer keep wires neatly arranged, with optional tray and in-desk power for heavy-duty setups
  • Customize with Desk Tray, Desk Hook and/or Headphone Stand
  • Built-in Bluetooth pairs with the Branch Ergonomics app for virtual presets, stand tracking, scheduled stands and more
  • Meets BIFMA standard for commercial-grade use, and backed by the Branch Warranty for 10 years
